messages:
alice: Publishing py/ts SDK canary 0.12.3-canary -> npm & pypi now. watch the gates please.
release-bot: deploy started: package publish job 4721 for packages: @redwood/sdk-js@0.12.3-canary, redwood-sdk-py==0.12.3rc1
ben: seeing a checksum mismatch on the npm tarball... request failed integrity check when installing from the registry
claire: can you paste the npm error? node 18?
ben: npm ERR! sha512 integrity check failed for @redwood/sdk-js/-/sdk-js-0.12.3-canary.tgz
ben: local sha512 vs registry disagree
alice: omg. hold on. don't promote to canary tag. i'm pausing the rollout.
alice: @dave can you check CI artifacts? maybe release job re-uploaded the wrong file.
dave: on it. downloading artifact log
dave: logs show two publish steps, second one re-packaged with different build env. suspect yarn pack produced different tarball
emi: quick decision: do we yank the npm canary and unpublish the pyrc from TestPyPI? risks: break users who already installed
claire: if it's only canary, safest is to unpublish both and republish consistent artifacts. then re-run integration smoke
ben: agree. I'll run npm unpublish @redwood/sdk-js@0.12.3-canary now
release-bot: npm unpublish queued by ben
ben: done. npm shows package removed. pinging pypi admin to remove redwood-sdk-py==0.12.3rc1
dave: creating follow-up CI patch to ensure deterministic packaging: pin node/yarn and add checksum verification step
alice: good. also add note in release notes draft: 'Canary briefly published then retracted due to packaging checksum mismatch — republishing with deterministic packaging'
emi: update docs? set temp note on release page and pin canary in canary-channels doc.
claire: for next steps: 1) add CI checksum step 2) republish from a single job 3) run smoke tests 4) announce new canary 5) update changelog
alice: timeline: aim to republish in 30m. I'll coordinate with comms for a short note.
ben: thanks. i'll keep monitoring registry and will post if anything else fails :thumbsup:
release-bot: deploy finished: unpublish tasks completed
alice: closing loop — we'll re-open thread if republish hits issues
